scope: Independent evidence re-audit after corpus repair, authoring-contract repair, and the frozen deterministic receiver study. No lesson, course, corpus, generator, receiver, manifest, provenance, or prior report was edited by this audit.

readiness.meaning: The lesson may now author both the decision contract and measured synthetic-study results. It must present the receiver as a falsifiable implementation with two passed targets and two failed targets, not as a conforming or deployed receiver.
readiness.hard_condition: The writer must supersede the repaired brief/course sentences that say no executable study exists, preserve the frozen denominators and study scope, and disclose the negative-control and latency failures next to any positive accuracy result.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: The obsolete key5-short-25ms-must-reject.wav is removed. The regenerated corpus contains key5-short-20ms-must-reject.wav at 160 tone samples, key5-short-25ms-indeterminate.wav at 200 tone samples, and the retained 45 ms/360-sample operate-side fixture. Manifest and provenance label 25 ms as gray and exclude it from conformance accuracy; the study separately excludes all 128 gray trials at 24-39 ms.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Twenty milliseconds is a mandatory non-operation fixture; 25 ms is indeterminate; 45 ms satisfies only the duration side when all other gates pass.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: receiver_study.py freezes candidate thresholds, five deterministic seeds, split sizes, impairments, 17 labels, row-normalized confusion matrices, denominators, and latency origin, then writes a reproducible held-out result. Clean and hard positive targets pass; all-negative rejection and hard-set maximum latency targets fail.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Performance is no longer merely prospective, but the sentence 'all targets passed' is false. Report each target separately.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: The study does not use the N=205 feature frame as its timing gate. It uses 40-sample/5 ms temporal blocks, a 40 ms candidate span, at least 30 ms above the energy threshold, at most 10 ms consecutive interruption, and a separate 160-sample/20 ms spectral record. Latency is measured from first signal-only sample at receiver input to the decision-block boundary. The measured hard-set maximum is 50 ms, so the <=40 ms goal fails. Source-origin reporting still adds the course FIR's separate 50-sample/6.25 ms group delay and declared alignment convention.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: The timing mechanism is auditable, but the receiver does not meet the 40 ms maximum-latency target. Do not attach the study result to the brief's N=205 cost frame.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: The repaired brief and course block distinguish exact C(f), N=205 DFT bins, and zero-padded N=256 FFT bins. The executed receiver uses eight direct exact-nominal correlations over N=160 and never labels them FFT bins. The strategy exercise now requires same-coordinate comparisons and unit-separated cost ledgers.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Do not claim coefficient identity across exact-nominal and FFT-grid strategies or a universal implementation winner.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: The nonexistent 12-key exercise claim was removed. Corpus metadata retains Q.23 order 123A456B789C*0#D, and the study freezes 16-key balanced splits: 32 clean trials per key and 64 hard trials per key, plus a separate 640-trial reject set.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Describe a 16-key study. Do not silently exclude A-D or call it a 12-key evaluation.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: Generator, manifest, provenance, repaired brief, course block, receiver script, and result consistently identify synthetic PCM plus the deterministic 101-tap 300-3400 Hz course FIR. No real/acoustic, reverb, clipping, speech, dial-tone, echo, browser-capture, deployed, or standards-conforming evidence is asserted.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Keep every result scoped to the deterministic synthetic laboratory study.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: Legacy 15 dB files remain explicitly whole-sequence SNR. Two corpus files use an active-tone mask and independently measure 9.999997560160093 dB and 9.999997842109162 dB after PCM. The study generates separate per-episode 10 dB noise normalized over the known active interval at receiver input; all 1024 hard trials declare 10 dB.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Call the study condition active-tone SNR. Do not reuse legacy 15 dB filenames as 15 dB active-tone evidence and do not imply that the two committed 10 dB sequence fixtures are the randomized held-out grid.

original_blocker_resolution.evidence: The executable receiver freezes pause, duration/interruption, group energy, winner-to-runner dominance, high/low twist, detuning, row-column mapping, and REJECT behavior. Training selects numeric thresholds before held-out scoring. The gates reject 637/640 mandatory negative controls, so the logic exists but its all-reject target is not met.
original_blocker_resolution.writer_effect: Teach the explicit gates and then expose the three false accepts. Do not call the receiver conforming or say every mandatory negative is rejected.

reproducibility_audit.python_syntax: python3 -m py_compile passed for generate.py and receiver_study.py

fresh_corpus_run.result: fresh generation in an empty temporary directory matched every committed clip and CSV byte-for-byte

matrix_invariants.shape: all clean, hard, negative, and combined confusion matrices are 17x17

no_test_leakage_audit.training_only_path: calibrate_block_threshold receives only the 640 training trials; calibrate_spectral_thresholds receives only those training trials and their extracted features. Held-out evaluation occurs afterward and no held-out metric is passed back into either selector.
no_test_leakage_audit.independent_split_state: Each split instantiates a separate LCG with a distinct frozen seed. Creating or changing a non-training split cannot advance the training generator state.
no_test_leakage_audit.perturbation_check: Flipping all four non-training seeds left every training sample and label identical and left all six selected thresholds unchanged.
no_test_leakage_audit.candidate_order: All candidate arrays and the deterministic tie-break rule are literals in the script. Block threshold 0.028 is the unique reported maximum balanced rate; the selected spectral tuple is the earliest candidate among the tied perfect-training candidates under the declared ordering.
no_test_leakage_audit.limitation: This verifies no held-out access in the executable selection path. Because the script and report are not accompanied by an external pre-registration timestamp, it cannot prove that a human never revised the coded candidate grid after seeing an earlier run. Phrase the protocol as frozen within this committed execution, not as independently preregistered.

frozen_protocol.spectral_record: last 160 samples =20 ms, rectangular, before temporal qualification
frozen_protocol.coordinates: eight direct exact-nominal correlations C(f); detuning scan from -4% through +4% in 0.25 percentage-point steps around the winning nominal row and column
frozen_protocol.temporal_schedule: 40-sample/5 ms non-overlapping energy blocks; >=40 ms candidate span; >=30 ms above threshold; <=10 ms consecutive sub-threshold interruption; >=40 ms preceding quiet blocks

split_contract.heldout_clean: 512 =32/key; no noise, offset, twist, or channel
split_contract.heldout_10db_pm1_5pct: 1024 =64/key; active-tone SNR 10 dB; independent low/high offsets sampled inside +/-1.5%; independent phases and twist; 512 channel trials
split_contract.negative_controls: 640 =64 each of lone low, lone high, two low, two high, detuned, twist low, twist high, <=23 ms duration, <40 ms pause, and noise only

frozen_protocol.latency_origin: first signal-only sample at receiver input to the boundary of the block that first qualifies; rejected trials have no decision latency
frozen_protocol.combined_denominator: heldout_clean + heldout_10db_pm1_5pct + negative_controls only; training and gray_duration_excluded omitted

training.use: threshold calibration only, never a held-out performance claim

heldout_10db_pm1_5pct.only_error: hard-*-010: true '*', predicted REJECT by twist gate; unchanneled, 50 ms tone, 60 ms pause, actual offsets -0.538801014306955% low and -0.05071669409517199% high, generated twist -7.990464703645557 dB

false_accepts: negative-insufficient_pause_lt_40ms-013 -> 2 at 42 ms; generated pause 38 ms

hard_latency_target.metric: maximum latency among accepted heldout_10db_pm1_5pct trials from received-signal onset

combined_conformance_heldout.composition: 512 clean key trials +1024 hard key trials +640 mandatory negative controls
combined_conformance_heldout.warning: This pooled accuracy is reproducible but is not one of the per-condition targets and depends on the frozen class mixture. Do not lead with it or present it without the denominator and composition.

gray_duration.warning: These outputs are local behavior in the 24-39 ms gray region, not correctness labels and not part of any accuracy or confusion denominator.

exact_writer_claims_allowed: In this deterministic synthetic study, the frozen receiver scored 512/512 (100%) on the held-out clean split, passing the prospective >=99% target.
On 1024 held-out synthetic key trials at 10 dB active-tone SNR with independently drawn low/high offsets inside +/-1.5%, it scored 1023/1024 (99.90234375%), passing the prospective >=95% target.
It rejected 637/640 (99.53125%) mandatory negative controls, missing the all-rejected target because one two-low, one low-twist, and one insufficient-pause trial were emitted as keys.
Among 1023 accepted hard trials, received-onset latency had median 45 ms, p95 45 ms, and maximum 50 ms; the maximum therefore failed the <=40 ms target.
The study receiver used a 160-sample exact-nominal spectral record and 5 ms temporal blocks. These measured results do not validate the lesson's separate N=205 or padded N=256 cost alternatives.
Training and all 128 gray-duration trials were excluded from the combined 2176-trial conformance confusion denominator.
The generator and receiver study reproduce byte-for-byte under Python 3.12.3 with the recorded script and channel hashes.
required_failure_disclosures: State all_declared_targets_met=false wherever the study is summarized.
Place 637/640 and the three false-accept categories next to the clean and hard positive accuracies; do not hide them in an appendix.
Place maximum accepted hard latency 50 ms next to the <=40 ms target and label it FAIL. Do not report only the 45 ms median or p95.
The single hard-set error is a false reject near the generated low-twist edge, not a wrong-key substitution.
Do not treat gray-duration outputs as accuracy, and do not include their 92 accepts or 36 rejects in a conformance denominator.

Do not call the result standards conformance: randomized hard offsets lie inside the range rather than proving every inclusive endpoint, the study does not execute the committed boundary WAVs, and many real-channel impairments are absent.
Do not imply statistical confidence or population generalization from deterministic synthetic draws.
